class.name: SongData
class.brief_description: Stores parsed musical timing and structural data for a song.
class.description: A [Resource] that holds the parsed output of a MusicXML file. This includes tempo data, measure start times, beats-per-measure information, and cue markers. [AudioClock], [TransitionManager], and higher-level playback scripts use this data to convert raw playback time into musical context.

method.name: add_cue_point
method.description: Adds a cue marker at [param measure_index]. This updates both [member cues_by_measure] and [member cues_by_name] so the cue can be resolved efficiently in either direction.

members.member: Stores the number of beats in each measure. This is primarily the time-signature numerator for each measure and is used by the clock to emit correct beat events.
Stores the BPM value active at each measure.
Lookup dictionary mapping internal 0-based measure indices to arrays of cue names found at those measure starts.
Lookup dictionary mapping cue names to arrays of internal 0-based measure indices where those cues occur.
Stores the exact start time in seconds for each measure, plus a final fencepost entry representing the end of the song.
